name: Triangulum Australe
introduction: is the Southern Triangle, introduced by Dutch navigators in the 1590s. Its three bright stars form a neat triangle near Alpha Centauri.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Unlike its northern counterpart, the Southern Triangle is bright and easy to recognize, making it a useful guide in southern skies.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Atria](hip:82273), the brightest star, is an orange giant 391 light-years away. [Beta Trianguli Australis](hip:77952) is a white star 41 light-years away, and [Gamma Trianguli Australis](hip:74946) a white star.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Triangulum Australe contains the open cluster NGC 6025.
